step1_analysis.description: A latch-type sense amplifier designed for SRAM applications. It features capacitive input coupling and a cross-coupled pair to amplify small differential signals, with open-drain output buffers.

paper_reference.title: Dynamic Body Charge Modulation for Sense Amplifiers in Partially Depleted SOI Technology

sense_delay.description: Time delay from the sense amplifier enable (SAE) signal going active to the output resolving.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the parasitic capacitance of the internal nodes and the drive strength of the cross-coupled PMOS/NMOS devices at 1.8V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Sky130 at 1.8V is a mature bulk node; delay should be comparable or slightly slower than a specialized SOI process at 1.0V depending on device sizing.

power_consumption.description: Average power consumed during a sensing cycle.

sky130_expected.calculation: Integration of VDD current during the transient switching event multiplied by VDD (1.8V).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Dynamic power dominates during the latch resolution phase.

voltage_swing.description: Maximum differential voltage achieved at the internal latch nodes.

sky130_expected.calculation: Full rail-to-rail swing in a standard CMOS latch.
sky130_expected.reasoning: At 1.8V VDD, the cross-coupled pair should pull the nodes close to the rails.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure the sense delay and power consumption of the sense amplifier. Pull-up resistors are added to the open-drain outputs (N4, N6) for observation.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Sense Amplifier Testbench
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
* SAE signal (active low)
VSAE LABEL_NET_3 0 PULSE(1.8 0 1n 20p 20p 5n 10n)
* Input coupling signals to create initial differential
VINP LABEL_NET_0 0 PULSE(1.8 0 0.5n 20p 20p 10n 20n)
VINN LABEL_NET_5 0 1.8

* DUT
XM1 N4 VDD N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N6 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N6 VDD N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 LABEL_NET_0 N0 N0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 GND LABEL_NET_3 N5 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 VDD VDD N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N1 VDD N0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N1 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N4 N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N5 N0 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N5 N1 N0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 N0 VDD VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM14 LABEL_NET_5 N1 GND VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}

* Load capacitors and pull-up resistors for open-drain outputs
C0 N0 0 10f
C1 N1 0 10f
R1 N4 VDD 10k
R2 N6 VDD 10k

* Initial conditions for precharged internal nodes
.ic v(N0)=1.8 v(N1)=1.8 v(N5)=1.8

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.control
tran 10p 3n

* Measure delay from SAE falling to internal nodes resolving
meas tran delay_sense_n1 trig v(LABEL_NET_3) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(N1) val=0.9 fall=1
meas tran delay_sense_n0 trig v(LABEL_NET_3) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(N0) val=0.9 fall=1

* Measure delay to buffered outputs
meas tran delay_out_n4 trig v(LABEL_NET_3) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(N4) val=0.9 fall=1
meas tran delay_out_n6 trig v(LABEL_NET_3) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(N6) val=0.9 fall=1

* Measure final voltage swing
meas tran v_n0_final find v(N0) at=2.5n
meas tran v_n1_final find v(N1) at=2.5n
let v_swing = abs(v_n0_final - v_n1_final)
print v_swing

* Measure average power consumption during sensing
meas tran avg_current avg i(VVDD) from=1n to=3n
let avg_power = -avg_current * 1.8
print avg_power

quit
.endc
